name: Wolfgang Seidel
bio: Took a Porsche 550 Spyder to eighth overall and the 1500 Sport class win in the 1955 Mille Miglia with Helm Gloeckler. With Edgar Barth he won the 1959 Targa Florio in a 718 RSK, giving Porsche its first World Sportscar Championship victory. Twelve Grand Prix entries between 1953 and 1962 brought him no points at all; more often than not he had entered the car himself, under his own name or as Scuderia Colonia.
